title: Seagrove "Sun Sational" 76 Brown Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the beach- Complimentary beach set up (2 chairs/1 umbrella April 25th,2026, thru May 2026)- Parking lot is available at Eastern Lake Beach Access- Private heated pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $25 per day**- 3 nearby beach accesses: Ram's Gate, Eastern Lake, and Walton Dunes- 6-Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Grilling area- Stainless steel appliances- Beautiful open floor plan- 4 adult bikes- Parking for 3 vehicles- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Nestled in the heart of Seagrove Beach, Sun Sational features 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms that can comfortably accommodate 12 guests. Spend leisurely days on the sun-soaked beaches or glide down the Timpoochee Trail to visit nearby Seaside and WaterColor—only a 16-minute bike ride. Guests will love the private heated pool, expansive outdoor courtyard, and a quick 6-minute walk to beach access.Natural light showcases a thoughtful design aesthetic as guests step inside the entryway, prepped to catch the day’s beach bags and gear. The living, dining, and kitchen areas share an open-concept floor plan, allowing guests to maximize their time together. A gourmet kitchen with white cabinetry and premium appliances offers a spacious place to prepare meals. The dining table seats 8 guests, with room for an additional 5 at the kitchen breakfast bar. In the living area, wood floors and natural elements create a welcoming space to gather on comfortable seating surrounding a 65” TV. The room opens to a covered patio overlooking the home’s outdoor private oasis with a pool and propane grill. A guest bedroom with a king bed, TV, and a private bathroom is in the front hall.A primary bedroom, a guest bedroom, and a bunk room are on the second floor. Guests staying in the primary bedroom will enjoy a king bed, TV, a private covered balcony overlooking the courtyard, and a private bathroom. The guest bedroom down the hall features a king bed, TV, and private bathroom. The bunk room is ideal for kids or teens and has a TV, 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds, and a private bathroom. A laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer is adjacent to the bunk room.With 3 nearby beach access points and a private pool, Sun Sational is perfect for a relaxing Seagrove Beach vacation. Parking is available for 3 vehicles, and guests can explore on a complimentary 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle or the 4 included adult bikes. The nearest beach access is a 6-minute walk, located between 471 and 493 Eastern Lake Road. To find the access, take a left on Eastern Lake Road from the property. Book this beautiful home today.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Queen Full Sleeper- Half BathroomSECOND FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Please be aware that neighboring property enhancements may cause intermittent daytime noise.

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Seagrove "Sun Sational" 76 Brown Street Santa Rosa Beach, FL Bedrooms 4 Beds 8 Sleeps 12 Full Baths 4 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Short walk to the beach - Complimentary beach set up (2 chairs/1 umbrella April 25th,2026, thru May 2026) - Parking lot is available at Eastern Lake Beach Access - Private heated pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $25 per day** - 3 nearby beach accesses: Ram's Gate, Eastern Lake, and Walton Dunes - 6-Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - Grilling area - Stainless steel appliances - Beautiful open floor plan - 4 adult bikes - Parking for 3 vehicles - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Nestled in the heart of Seagrove Beach, Sun Sational features 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms that can comfortably accommodate 12 guests. Spend leisurely days on the sun-soaked beaches or glide down the Timpoochee Trail to visit nearby Seaside and WaterColor—only a 16-minute bike ride. Guests will love the private heated pool, expansive outdoor courtyard, and a quick 6-minute walk to beach access. Natural light showcases a thoughtful design aesthetic as guests step inside the entryway, prepped to catch the day’s beach bags and gear. The living, dining, and kitchen areas share an open-concept floor plan, allowing guests to maximize their time together. A gourmet kitchen with white cabinetry and premium appliances offers a spacious place to prepare meals. The dining table seats 8 guests, with room for an additional 5 at the kitchen breakfast bar. In the living area, wood floors and natural elements create a welcoming space to gather on comfortable seating surrounding a 65” TV. The room opens to a covered patio overlooking the home’s outdoor private oasis with a pool and propane grill. A guest bedroom with a king bed, TV, and a private bathroom is in the front hall. A primary bedroom, a guest bedroom, and a bunk room are on the second floor. Guests staying in the primary bedroom will enjoy a king bed, TV, a private covered balcony overlooking the courtyard, and a private bathroom. The guest bedroom down the hall features a king bed, TV, and private bathroom. The bunk room is ideal for kids or teens and has a TV, 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds, and a private bathroom. A laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer is adjacent to the bunk room. With 3 nearby beach access points and a private pool, Sun Sational is perfect for a relaxing Seagrove Beach vacation. Parking is available for 3 vehicles, and guests can explore on a complimentary 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle or the 4 included adult bikes. The nearest beach access is a 6-minute walk, located between 471 and 493 Eastern Lake Road. To find the access, take a left on Eastern Lake Road from the property. Book this beautiful home today.
